Some practical advice, this morning
A memorable cycle is easier with a plan
Travelers with pets need to check every rule before they come to the airport.

Pet Travel Alert

Bring carriers that close securely, keep leashes ready, and follow the calm directions from the handling staff. Sudden moves, loud voices, and loose gear can upset animals and slow boarding. If your pet seems stressed, tell the desk right away so the team can help.

Keep your paperwork in order and read all notices before you leave home. Claims linked to travel problems must be filed fast, and the desk can explain the process if you ask in person. <<FACT F120>> If your departure runs late, the standard payout guidance still applies. <<FACT F109>> The Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you sort the next steps without delay.

Go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for direct help before boarding.
